# transactional-outbox

> Transactional outbox: enqueue events in the caller's database transaction and relay them at least once with leases, jittered backoff and dead-lettering Python package `trysac-transactional-outbox`, import name `transactional_outbox`, MIT licensed,
> Python >= 3.10, no runtime dependencies.
